text:
QUOTE: "Current user is removed from the channel locally, and the channel is dropped from its managed category" (archiveChannel, when 'false'); "If the current channel is the one archived, kicks the user out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel" (websocket handler, when 'false'); "Archive keeps the channel locally and sets `delete_at` to now" / "Only updates `delete_at`" (when viewable)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable the user is removed and kicked out if it is the current channel, and when viewable the channel is kept with delete_at set (marked deleted).
